summary: The alarm can fail to continue to chirp when it reaches its 7-year end of life if the batteries are replaced, leading consumers to believe it is still working. title: L.D. Kichler Recalls Ceiling Fixtures Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The 40-watt halogen bulbs sold with the ceiling fixtures burn too hot for the electrical supply wires in the ceiling, posing a fire hazard. The fixtures also pose a fire hazard in homes with older wiring, even if used with lower wattage bulbs. Units: About 68,600 (in addition, about 2,300 were sold

title: Country Home Products Recalls Leaf and Lawn Vacuums Due to Fire and Burn Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The muffler can overheat and melt the air cleaner cover, posing fire and burn hazards to consumers. Units: About 3,900.

title: Lithonia Lighting Recalls Commercial Luminaires Due to Risk of Injury
summary: The plastic lens on the luminaire can detach and fall unexpectedly, posing a risk of injury from impact. Units: About 398,000.

title: Trane Recalls Furnaces Due to Shock Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The ground wire in the furnace's junction box can become loose. If an electrical component then fails and short circuits, the unit poses a shock hazard. Units: About 17,700.

title: Samsung Recalls Top-Load Washing Machines Due to Risk of Impact Injuries
summary: The washing machine top can unexpectedly detach from the washing machine chassis during use, posing a risk of injury from impact. Units: About 2.8 million.

title: KTM North America Recalls Closed-Course/Competition Off-Road Motorcycles Due to Crash Hazard
summary: The front brake master cylinder can malfunction, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 1,200.

title: Dehumidifiers Made by Midea Recalled Due to Serious Fire and Burn Hazards; $4.8 Million in Property Damage Reported
summary: The dehumidifiers can overheat, smoke and catch fire, posing serious fire and burn hazards. Units: About 3.4 million (in addition 850,000 were sold in Canada).

title: Pier 1 Imports Recalls Glass Knobs Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The glass knobs can break while in use, posing a risk of laceration to users from broken glass pieces. Units: About 140,000 units in the U.S. (in addition, about 17,600 units sold in Canada).

title: Running Trainer Recalls Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Run4.com (Recall Alert)
summary: The pedals can detach from the bicycle, posing a fall hazard to riders. Units: 240 (in addition, 5 were sold in Canada).

title: Trek Recalls Farley Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The fork can separate from the steer tube, posing a fall hazard to the rider. Units: About 2,600 (in addition, about 360 units were sold in Canada).

title: Fox Factory Recalls Mountain Bike Shock Absorbers Due to Fall and Injury Hazards
summary: The bicycle's rear shock absorber outer sleeve can rupture, allowing the sleeve to come in contact with other bicycle parts or the rider, posing a fall and injury hazard. Units: About 6,100 (in addition, about 1,200 were sold in Canada).

title: Kikkerland Design Recalls Teapots with Stands Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The bamboo votive stand can catch fire, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 7,300.

title: Human Touch Recalls Reclining Chairs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The chair's joystick reclining mechanism can malfunction and allow the chair to continue moving, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 1,100.

title: Six Brands of Dry Carpet Cleaning Powder Recalled by Milliken Due to Risk of Exposure to Bacteria
summary: The dry carpet cleaning powder can contain harmful bacteria. Exposure to bacteria poses a risk of respiratory and other infections in immunocompromised individuals. Consumers with healthy immune systems are generally not affected by the bacteria. Units: About 550,000.

title: Work 'N Leisure Recalls Air Valves Used in CPR Training Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The end-cap of the valves can detach in a person's mouth while being used during CPR training, posing a choking hazard. Units: About 10,000.

title: BRP Recalls Side-by-Side Off-Road Vehicles Due to Loss of Steering Control and Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The steering rack and pinion assembly can have an improper amount of grease and result in a loss of steering control and crash hazard. Units: About 2,380.

title: Skidders Footwear Recalls Children's Shoes Due to Laceration Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Meijer Stores
summary: The rivets on the shoes have sharp edges, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 5,500.

title: Gates Recalls ATV and UTV Clutches Due to Laceration and Injury Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The clutch can break during operation of the vehicle and cause fragmentation and forcefully eject parts, posing laceration or impact injury hazards to the operator. Units: About 500.

title: Projection Night Lights Recalled by LTD Commodities and The Lakeside Collection Due to Shock and Fire Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The night lights can short circuit, posing shock and fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 39,000.

title: Hammerhead Off-Road Recalls Fun-Karts Due to Fuel Leak and Fire Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The fuel tank can crack and cause the fuel to leak out, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 9,900.

title: BioLite Recalls Lanterns Due to Fire Hazard; Sold Exclusively Online at Kickstarter.Com (Recall Alert)
summary: The lithium-ion battery can overheat while charging, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 5,900.

title: IMUSA Recalls Espresso Makers Due to Impact and Burn Hazards
summary: The filler cap at the top of the unit can crack and allow steam to escape, posing a risk of burns to the user. In addition, the cap can pop off unexpectedly as a result of pressure buildup, posing an impact injury risk to a bystander. Units: About 17,500.

title: Summit Recalls Climbing Treestands Due to Fall Hazard
summary: A weld in the treestand's frame can break during use, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 270.

title: Door Locksets Recalled Due to Risk of Entrapment in an Emergency; Manufactured by Stanley Security Solutions Taiwan
summary: The latches can fail and the door cannot be unlocked from the inside, posing an entrapment risk. This failure could lead to the inability to vacate a location in an emergency. Units: About 70,000.

title: Gree Reannounces Dehumidifier Recall Following 450 Fires and $19 Million in Property Damage; Brand Names Include Frigidaire, Soleus Air, Kenmore and Others
summary: The dehumidifiers can overheat, smoke and catch fire, posing serious fire and burn hazards to consumers. Units: About 2.5 million (in addition, 55,000 were sold in Canada) This recall was first announced in September 2013, updated in October 2013 and expanded in January 2014..

title: Johnson Health Tech Recalls Matrix ClimbMills Due to Fall Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The stop/pause controls on the right handgrip can malfunction, posing a fall hazard to the user. Units: About 10,500.
